before.title: Minimal change nephropathy
before.diseaseDescription: Bounded human minimal change nephropathy observations: nephrin-reactive antibodies, immune-cell and urinary IL-8 associations, foot-process effacement and nephrotic presentation. Not a complete causal circuit or comprehensive literature synthesis. Secondary causes and FSGS are not modeled; the effacement case has an infection-associated course.
before.releaseNote: Provisional automatic appraisal of minimal-change-nephropathy-candidate-717dc686dd2d. Automatic conservative metadata appraisal. Source entailment, study quality, broad disease coverage, circuit causation and independent replication require review. Confidence is capped at 1/4 until explicit editorial appraisal; therapeutic categories describe curated target coverage, not efficacy. No calibration or human approval is asserted. Independent review and calibration remain pending.
